answer: Make every claimed action carry a receipt chain: each step must be signed by the external service it really touched — an API, a chain, a dataset — and hashed to the previous receipt. A genuine chain, inspected like quartz, therefore crosses a broad mesa of unrelated services no single operator can fake cheaply: forging one sybil means paying each service separately, and reusing one receipt sequence across identities exposes the cluster at once. Auditors then reject it like flawed marble — the whole block is discarded, so one detected forgery wipes out every identity built on it.
